work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Gregory transfers the old Cádiz cathedral’s rights to the completed new cathedral and chapter. Full dispositive text, derogation and complete closing precede allocution XIV. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF6851–6851; the source closing at LF6949–6952 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima aprilis millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo, pontificatus No- stri anno decimo..  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
